archetype: four-building avenue frontage with furnished cellars, mixed ground uses and apartment/office floors

city_grade.sidewalks: five-block stone walks on both sides of a nine-block avenue
city_grade.frontages: two independently massed buildings on each side of the street

building_programs: west-north cafe with dining room, service counter, kitchen, store cellar and two apartment floors
west-south hardware shop with retail aisles, repair workshop, receiving cellar and three office floors
east-north pharmacy and clinic with dispensary, exam support, medical cellar and three residential floors
east-south post and bank hall with public counter, sorting desks, records, secure store cellar and two office floors
circulation: independent street and rear-service doors for every premise
separate public, staff and rear secure rooms on every ground floor
four furnished cellars reached by dedicated four-rise stairs
rear upper corridors serving two independently roomed suites per floor
four complete stacked stairs linking ground and every upper floor
damage_constraints: lower the avenue from city grade Y=4 to roadbed Y=1
feather both sidewalks with broken soil and gravel ramps rather than vertical cuts
expose and locally breach real cellar street walls
confine facade/floor failures to four different declared zones
preserve every stair stack, every ground business and at least one coherent upper suite per floor
derive subsidence, rubble, occupation and loot only from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: all four buildings read as different premises rather than paired boxes
street, service, cellar and upper-floor circulation work at player scale
the avenue is visibly three blocks below surviving city grade
soil and broken sidewalks feather naturally into the road trench
collapsed floors, exposed cellars and dirt intrusion follow gravity
survivor spaces remain dangerous but navigable
